integrity: The exact formulas follow from a proved Hurwitz/Lyapunov argument. Numerical finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-length identity.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous resonant tight-binding path; no bulk dephasing or detuning; two distinct irreversible boundary loss channels; rates J,a,b>0; initial interior-site flatness applies to localized inputs, not arbitrary coherent superpositions. Publication priority not independently certified.
title: Exact flat interior splitting and impedance matching for a coherent path with competing boundary sinks
